articles.title: Sequel to 'Scary Stories' Might Be Stuck in Legal Limbo!
articles.summary: A sequel to 'Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark' is ready to go, but the rights are tangled up because the two studios that made the first movie no longer exist.

articles.title: Sleeping Giant Gaia Steals the Show at Chelsea Flower Show!
articles.summary: A giant sleeping figure of Mother Nature, made from a fallen tree and willow branches, won top prize at the Chelsea Flower Show. The garden celebrates wild, overlooked spaces.

articles.title: Latin America's Biggest Creativity Festival Is Back and Bigger Than Ever!
articles.summary: Rio2C, the largest creativity gathering in Latin America, expects to break attendance records with 55,000+ people. This year it's bringing together creators from Brazil and Spanish-speaking countries.
